name: House of Nightmares
source: In this game, you are sent an invitation to the Manor House. There, you meet England, Germany, Italy, America, Cry, and PewDiePie. You are told that you are not allowed to leave until you get rid of all the demons and ghosts in the house. You explore the mansion with your group, and along the way you experience horror, mystery, conspiracy, love, and a passion for revenge.
translation: 在这个游戏中，你将收到一份前往庄园的邀请函。在那里，你会遇到英国、德国、意大利、美国、Cry和PewDiePie。你被告知，除非你消灭了房子里所有的恶魔和鬼魂，否则你不准离开。你和你的团队一起探索这座豪宅，一路上你会经历恐怖、神秘、阴谋、爱情和复仇的热情。
